status: Reference-derived; corporate logo artwork is intentionally not copied

typography.hierarchy: Short section label, large declarative title, one dominant message, restrained supporting text

branding.wordmark_treatment: Editable typographic label with a cyan rule; no corporate logo image embedded
branding.draft_label: PROJECT PITCH · DRAFT · NOT AN APPROVAL
branding.footer: Classification, project version, draft status, and slide number

narrative_rules: Select a small set of layouts from the approved model rather than restyling per generated slide.
Lead with the message and use visual sequence or contrast instead of dense bullet lists.
Use editable PowerPoint text and vector shapes; do not flatten slides to images.
Preserve attribution, claim classification, uncertainty, recommendation, and pilot boundary.
Keep a small discussion/live-annotation area on the decision slide.
image_policy: Use only when present in approved project assets and license/rights are reviewed. The MVP deck uses editable vector diagrams and no stock or generated images.
template_asset_policy: The reference files inform this profile but are not bundled, redistributed, or copied into the public demo.
